shared_elements: low-relief figural motifs carved on an upright stone surface
curved, hook-like or beaked forms suggestive of creatures
multiple motifs distributed over a single broad face
justification:
Both surfaces carry shallow relief creature-like motifs with curved, beak- or snout-like projections spread over a broad stone face, which is about as generic a correspondence as relief iconography allows. A shows a clearly legible, ordered programme 
of stacked registers with a row of quadrupeds, a bird with outstretched neck, arm-like limbs, herringbone bands and pouch-shaped signs, whereas B shows only sparse, isolated curvilinear designs with no register structure, no repeated row, and no identifiable animal-plus-attribute combinations.
